title: Cybersecurity Foundations
tagline: Understand threats, secure what you build and respond to incidents
description: A developer-oriented security path. Learn the core concepts and the OWASP Top 10, get comfortable on Linux and the shell, use Python for tooling, secure APIs and authentication, and understand how containers and infrastructure are hardened.
audience: Developers and IT professionals who need a solid security foundation

stages.title: Cybersecurity fundamentals
stages.description: Threat models, vulnerabilities, OWASP Top 10, encryption and secure coding.

stages.title: Linux
stages.description: Users, permissions, services, logs and networking from the terminal.

stages.title: Bash
stages.description: Scripting for auditing, log analysis and automation.

stages.title: Python for security tooling
stages.description: Write scripts for scanning, parsing and automation.

stages.title: Securing APIs and authentication
stages.description: Authentication, authorisation, tokens, rate limiting and input validation.

stages.title: Hardening containers and infrastructure
stages.description: Least privilege, secrets management and secure Docker images.

seo.title: Cybersecurity Foundations Learning Path
seo.description: Roadmap through security fundamentals and the OWASP Top 10, Linux, Bash, Python tooling, API security and infrastructure hardening.
